title: Part 8
content_zh: The Tang dynasty fell, but its poetry remained. For a thousand years, every Chinese child has memorized these verses. They are the water we swim in — so fundamental to Chinese identity that we forget they were once the cry of a drunk poet under the moon.
content_en: The Tang dynasty fell, but its poetry remained. For a thousand years, every Chinese child has memorized these verses. They are the water we swim in — so fundamental to Chinese identity that we forget they were once the cry of a drunk poet under the moon.
